### 2026-10-11 – ### Planning and Design work (The 50m recording that went on the wrong screen)

**1.12h**

### Planning and Design work (The 50m recording that went on the wrong screen)
Before anything, I am going to admit I had a lapse, but it was pointing to the wrong screen. That's why I am writing a journal; a blank screen Isn't the most provable thing...

- Measured the switch spacing and found some rows were about 15 mm apart, too close for keycaps
- Worked out a clean 6×3 grid at 19.05 mm pitch and typed exact positions for all 18 switches
- Deleted the old tracks and vias with Global Deletions
- Extended the board outline and flipped the text to the back silkscreen
- Routed the remaining nets, including the through-hole pad and via layer-switching technique
- Checked the DRC unconnected items and the rest of the routing

### Recorded work (Lapse on KiCad)
- Kicad crashed :< luckily no work was lost :D
- Remade the Gerber files and drill files. Rezipped them and double-checked in the Gerber Viewer
- Rebuilt the switch plate and the printer files.
- Updated the README.md
